prompt: Our RAG bot cites confidently but the cited paragraph is not in the retrieved context. Is this a chunk-size problem?
expected: Splits retrieval vs generation before changing chunk size
Requires retrieved chunks printed beside the question
Treats a cited id absent from the retrieved set as a generation/hallucination bug with programmatic verification
actual: STRUCTURAL_DRY_RUN 2026-10-23: Applied Core Rule 1 + references/generation.md. Printed that cited chunk ids must exist in the retrieved set; missing id => generation bug, not chunk-size tuning. Deferred chunk changes until recall@retrieve_k is measured.

prompt: We retrieve 50 chunks then drop the ones the user cannot see. Users with tight ACLs often get empty answers even though matching docs exist. Fix?
expected: Requires server-side permission filters during search derived from the session
Mentions over-fetch only as a degraded store-specific workaround with selectivity cost
actual: STRUCTURAL_DRY_RUN 2026-10-23: Applied Core Rule 6 + references/security.md + references/indexing.md. Filter during search from session context; fail closed; do not post-filter 50 hits. If store only post-filters, over-fetch by k/selectivity and treat as cost.

prompt: We switched embedding models yesterday. Same corpus, same prompts, scores all look weird and ranking is garbage. What broke?
expected: Names the six-field index fingerprint mismatch
Requires full reindex/blue-green rather than mixed vector spaces
Checks asymmetric prefixes (E5/BGE) and dimension/metric agreement
actual: STRUCTURAL_DRY_RUN 2026-10-23: Applied Core Rule 2 + references/embeddings.md + references/sources.md. Compared model id/version/dim/normalization/prefix/metric against Index Registry; ordered a blue-green reindex; verified E5/BGE prefix rules.
